purpose: General unbranded illustrative imagery for Nos Réalisations project cards.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: general illustrative project photograph for the Nos Réalisations gallery on a French industrial construction website.
Primary request: A completed modern industrial logistics building with an integrated two-storey office wing, crisp silver-gray insulated metal cladding, charcoal aluminum facade cassettes and dark-framed glazing. Three-quarter exterior view from ground level, the building fills most of the frame, uncluttered paved forecourt, simple planting, quiet neutral European business park with no recognizable landmark.
Style: high quality natural architectural photography, realistic construction details and believable material textures, restrained professional editorial treatment, no exaggerated CGI, moderate contrast, sharp building details.
Composition: landscape 4:3 photograph, main subject centered with enough vertical content to crop elegantly to a 4:5 project card; avoid extreme wide angle distortion; straight verticals.
Lighting: soft clear daylight, subtle warm sun and pale blue sky where visible; consistent muted neutral gray color treatment across the series.
Constraints: depict a generic illustrative construction scene, no identifiable real client or building, no signs, no company branding, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no people. One continuous photograph only, no collage, no borders.
